name: Poppy Seeds
siboNotes: Seeds are well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they're naturally FODMAP-free and provide healthy fats without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Toast lightly in a dry pan for enhanced nutty flavor
Grind for better nutrient absorption and easier digestion
Store in airtight container in refrigerator to prevent rancidity
Add to baked goods, salad dressings, or yogurt for texture
nutritionalHighlights: High in healthy monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats
Good source of calcium and magnesium for bone health
Provides dietary fiber for digestive health
